controls.seed: Repeatable original periodic hammer and wear fields; no gameplay RNG.
controls.resolution: Texture detail per shared family set; all inspection meshes reuse it.
controls.repeat_metres: Half metre physical repeat; fine samples crop the same texel density.
controls.albedo: Neutral sRGB metal reflectance; no lighting or emission painted in.
controls.roughness: Broad reflection width survives after small hammer marks mip away.
controls.hammer_mm: Shallow tangent-normal hammer relief, not structural or magical damage.
controls.seam_tint: Protected oxide/patina/tarnish on physical joint recesses.
controls.seam_metallic: Oxide reduces metallic response only at protected joints.
controls.rivet_radius_m: Silhouette and manufacturing identity of fasteners, kept within proxy envelope.
controls.bevel_m: Worked arris width, inside original bounds.
